author: creative-producer
statement: applyCommonGroundRail interact branch calls ctx.noteScreeningAction before ctx.performStoryInteraction. The real performStoryInteraction immediately checks screeningActionReady and refuses the now-consumed cadence. All ch13 movie interact acts therefore starve while their ready prompts remain visible.
requestedRepair: Let the shared performStoryInteraction own its existing cadence; remove premature consumption in chapter rail. Preserve real interaction resolver/input proof and no timeout rescue. Add a regression through applyCommonGroundRail with a cadence-aware shared performer rather than an always-success spy. Verify the actual home movie progression then the other ch13 interaction phases.
verificationState: Producer observed source cause and 70-second hardware movie stagnation. Fresh independent verifier still running; not yet its final finding.
